text:
```yaml
name: Community PR Permissions Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          separator: "\n"

      - name: Check for protected file changes
        run: |
          # List of protected files or patterns
          protected_files=(
            ".github/workflows/*"
            "docs/*"
            "airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml"
            "airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/metadata.yaml"
          )
          changed_files="${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}"
          for file in $changed_files; do
            for pattern in "${protected_files[@]}"; do
              if [[ "$file" == $pattern ]]; then
                echo "❌ PR modifies protected file: $file"
                exit 1
              fi
            done
          done
          echo "✅ No protected files modified."
        shell: bash
```
